result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** Round 249 is SABA-B-10a stage 1, the Insert Marker model.

**Round 248 closed on evidence.** C passed it in a real browser at both viewports, and the gate published `0e862be` to both remotes. That completes SABA-B-11b (all three stages) and closes ABL-R-8.
- Three new Lows went to `deferred_low_polish` (now 406): C-R248-01 (doc 186), GATE248-S1 (the Snap button doesn't look paused) and GATE248-S2 (screen readers aren't told about the pause).
- The gate reviewer's architecture note is recorded as a backlog signal only. I asked root again for both pending architecture checkpoints; neither is answered yet, and neither blocks.
- The regression round is due at the first planning on or after 2026-10-30. Today is 2026-10-29, so it is not due yet.

**Round 249 task.** It starts from HEAD `0e862be` with a clean tree. 10 files change (7 source, 3 tests, one of them new), plus a new doc 191. 1,099 files are frozen, including the 7 protected auth files.
- Space plays from the start of the time selection if there is one, otherwise from the Insert Marker. Pressed again, it stops.
- Shift+Space continues from where playback stopped.
- Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Space moves the marker to the playhead.
- Per Saba's decision, a click during playback moves only the marker; playback continues and the status line says so.
- Clicking a point clears a time selection.
- Cut Time also shifts the marker.
- The marker is hidden for now; SABA-B-10b draws it.

**Checks I ran on a copy outside the repo:**
- All 215 test files pass (3,123 tests), and tsc and Biome are clean.
- The review expected 44 test files to break on the Space change. Only one existing test (BR4b) had to change.
- 16 deliberately broken versions each failed the tests they should.
- Chromium at both viewports showed the old behaviour on HEAD and the new behaviour on the copy.

**Choices I made where the reference was unclear.** Each one is recorded and goes to Saba as a question; none blocks:
- Home and ↤ during playback still jump playback to 0, as now, and also move the marker (SABA-Q-10A-HOME-PLAYING).
- Ctrl+←/→ keep a time selection, because an existing feature uses the selection to pick tracks (SABA-Q-10A-CTRL-ARROW-RANGE).
- A seconds-ruler click now clears a selection, which Live's manual doesn't cover (added to SABA-Q-TIME-RULER-ROLE).
- The review's other deviations from Live are asked together (SABA-Q-10A-DEVIATIONS).
- Between now and SABA-B-9, the transport button still says "Pause" even though Space now stops (B-R249-PAUSE-LABEL, scheduled in SABA-B-9).
- Cmd+Shift+Space on a Mac can't be tested in the cloud, so it is on the Tech Lead list with a RETRO 260 deadline.

**Stage 2 comes next:** paste, add, split and M read the marker, the end-of-project message names the marker, and Follow behaves as in Live 6.2 (C-R235-02). Then SABA-B-10b, SABA-B-9 and SABA-B-11c. Nothing was dropped or deferred without approval.

Not COMPLETE, because large approved scope remains. Not BLOCKED, because only SABA-B-7 and phase 2 wait for Saba. The advisor was available and I used it twice, before writing and at the end; its final corrections are applied. I changed no app source.
